name: editable-cell
title: Editable Cell
description: Inline-editable value whose edit mode looks like view — same box, inherited type, no border — with optimistic saves, a delayed spinner, rollback plus a Retry toast on failure, required, multiline, table-cell and heading variants, and a typed text/select/custom editor registry.

meta.whenToUse: Any optimistic inline edit of a single value — grid cells (focusMode=managed), record-page property lists, settings rows — where the write is async and can fail.
meta.whenNotToUse: Debounced save-as-you-type on a standing form field (AutoSaveInput), or whole forms (Field).
